cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll open it. Be careful. We don't know what's inside.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika! You OK?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, how is she?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Her pulse is normal. Only her forehead is injured.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The blood loss isn't serious.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Huh? Oh...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hang on, Mika! It's me, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Gillian... Gillian...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika, what happened?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The chief. The chief was a Snatcher!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: He finally showed his true colors!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Harry... Harry...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Harry? What?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Harry put me in this booth and shut the main door,

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: trapping the Snatcher inside headquarters.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Even a Snatcher can't break through the shields here.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Harry?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Harry told me not to open the door, no matter what.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Then he went inside.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Gillian, save Harry!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Harry! Mika, open the shield. I'm going in.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal! We're going in! Stay alert!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Snatcher could be hiding anywhere!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Right.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Be careful, Gillian. The chief knows you inside out.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Don't let your guard down.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Gillian!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The lights have been destroyed.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The movement is heading away from us.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Running away?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I've lost the movement reading.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Snatcher got away!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Emergency lights on.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Did he get away?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's go after him!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: He's not getting away! He can't leave headquarters!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The Snatcher is wounded. Let's follow the blood.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The shield was open. Did Mika open it?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Huh? Mika's gone!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What happened?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The power went out.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Don't move, Gillian Seed.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Cunningham! It's you!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Movement detected. He's in here.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Where are you? Show yourself!

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Ha ha ha! I'm right here. I'm not running or hiding.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: No! Stay back, Gillian! It's a trap!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You coward! A hostage?

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Go ahead, Gillian! Shoot if you dare!

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: But if your hand slips, I can't promise she'll live!

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Gillian, shoot! Kill the Snatcher! Don't worry about me!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: What do we do?

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Here I come, JUNKER!

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: With twelve hours until the Kyoto Summit,

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: delegates from around the world are arriving in Kyoto.

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: Recent polls at home and abroad show growing support

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: for a complete quarantine of Neo Kobe,

cues.speaker: TV
cues.en: apparently driven by fears of Snatcher infiltration.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Old man!

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Oh, Gillian. I've gotten old. Look at me.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What happened?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I saw the chief tampering with your car.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: And that strange picture in his office.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, how is he? Metal!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I can't tell you.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That bad?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Gillian, when I confronted him, he showed his true form.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: All I could do was wound him.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I understand, old man. Don't talk. Metal, can't you do something?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You'll be fine. He says it's just a scratch. Good timing.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Why not take some time off and relax? You've been working too hard.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: It's all right. I know my own body. You're a good man.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Old man...

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I like you. I can't quite explain it.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I've never been good at telling people how I feel. That's it.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: You remind me of what I remember of my father.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Pulse and blood pressure dropping.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hang on, old man. We can share some Napoleon again.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: That sounds good. You, Jean and me. Metal, it's all right.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: It's all right. I've always been alone, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I never knew my parents or siblings.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: So I stubbornly went through life alone. Putting on a brave face.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Trusting no one. But I was wrong.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Blood pressure still falling.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Old man...

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: When Jean died, and now, I've felt human warmth. The human heart.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I understand.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Gillian. I wanted to live happily with everyone.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: For fifty years, I've wanted kindness.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: People who could trust each other.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: He's in danger, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I've talked too much. I'm counting on you, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Looks like they've come for me.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Even a lonely old man gets someone to take him home.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Old man!

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Gillian, you have to trust. The last JUNKER...

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Harry! Harry!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: His pulse has stopped. His pupils are dilated.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Cunningham! No, Snatcher! You'll pay for this!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: There's no time to grieve.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The Snatcher is still hiding inside headquarters.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Listen, Metal. If I die, take Mika and get out.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Blow up JUNKER headquarters. Understand?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood. I hope it won't come to that.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Where should we start looking?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The Snatcher has stopped functioning.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika, are you all right?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Yes. Thank you.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We got him, Randam. It took a while, but I paid you back.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: JUNKER! Don't think this is over!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: His last words. The Snatcher's energy is fading.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Queen Hospital was merely a facility

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: for maintaining our artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: There are still more of our comrades

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: in this city than you can possibly imagine.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Now we will begin the second phase.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: For that, we need Dr. Lorraine's help.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: You are insignificant, as long as your memory stays lost.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Bad luck, JUNKER!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: My memory. Snatchers. Dr. Lorraine.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Harry! Why? Why does it have to be the good people who die?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: This isn't right!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Mika, I won't let anyone else die. I swore to Harry and Randam.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: There are still Snatchers in this city.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Our fight against them has only just begun.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, an urgent call from Jamie. I'll connect you.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian, my memory's back!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Your memory's back? Who are we?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: We did something terrible.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie, what's wrong?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I can't say it over the videophone!

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I'd rather my memory had never come back!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: All right, Jamie. I'll be right there! Where are you?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I never should have woken... Gillian, I'm sorry. I can't tell you.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They're holding the child hostage.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The child?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Dr. Madnar is here, too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What are you talking about, Jamie?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I'm sorry. Snatchers! Gillian!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie! Jamie!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Gillian. We have Dr. Lorraine. We just need her to help us a little.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: At our Kremlin. Until then, behave yourself, Dr. Seed.
